text: 你们其中一人很快挣脱绳索并解开另一人。趁天色尚未暗到无法原路返回，你们勉强找回先前走过的路线。
你们找到被捆住的西尔维娅。诺曼割断绳索，她颤抖着倒进你怀里。她安静了几分钟，随后挺直身子；你几乎能看见她召回了那种支撑家族发迹的决心。
她准备好走路后，你们赶紧带队离开。研究祭祀地点或许有些人类学价值，但现在不是时候。你们短暂休息，等到黎明前再行动。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 564
text: One of you quickly slips out of his bonds and frees the other. You are just able to retrace your path before the failing light makes backtracking impossible.

You find the bound form of Sylvia. Norman cuts her bonds and she falls into your arms, trembling. She is quiet for a few minutes before she draws herself up, and you can almost see her summon the determination that built her family’s fortunes.
Once she is ready to walk, you hurry your group away. There might be some anthropological value in studying a place of sacrifice, but this is not the time for it. You take a brief rest before dawn.
